identical.nfcCards.heroDescription: A premium physical card with an NFC chip inside. Tap it on any phone and your digital card opens instantly — links, booking, socials, everything. Update it anytime without reprinting.
identical.nfcCards.how1d: Pick a style, add your name, links and photo.
identical.nfcCards.how2d: Your NFC chip + QR are programmed to your digital card.
identical.nfcCards.how3d: Ships to you. Tap phones, scan QRs, land clients.
identical.nfcCards.reservedDescription: Your digital card is already live. We'll reach out to confirm production and collect payment — nothing charged today.

identical.nfcCards.noCardsYet: No cards yet — build your first one above.
identical.nfcCards.faq1a: Every card has an NTAG213 NFC chip inside. Tap it against any modern phone and your digital card opens instantly — no app needed. Older phones can scan the QR printed on the back instead.
identical.nfcCards.faq2q: Can I change my links after ordering?
identical.nfcCards.faq2a: Yes — that's the whole point. Your card points to your digital profile, which you can edit anytime: links, title, bio, photo. The physical card never goes out of date.
identical.nfcCards.faq3a: You reserve today with no charge. Once we confirm your card with our production partner, we'll collect payment and your card ships straight to you.
identical.nfcCards.faq4q: How long until I get my card?
identical.nfcCards.faq4a: Cards are made to order. Expect production plus shipping to take 2–3 weeks once payment is confirmed. We'll keep you posted at every step.
identical.nfcCards.faq5q: Can I reorder or get cards for my team?
identical.nfcCards.faq5a: Yes — order any quantity, and each card gets its own digital profile. Team packs are perfect for realtors, barbershops, salons, and agencies.
